coastal.title: Pre-sale purchasers in troubled Lower Mainland condo tower win battle to declare contracts invalid
coastal.description: A B.C. judge has sided with dozens of pre-sale purchasers who claim the developer of a troubled Lower Mainland condo tower breached provincial consumer protection laws by failing to update them on the headwinds facing the development in the months before the project wound up in creditor protection proceedings.

prince-george.title: New hatcheries will see up to 1 million more salmon raised and released into Fraser and Skeena Rivers annually
prince-george.description: "Salmon are not simply a resource," Lheidli T'enneh Chief Dolleen Logan said at the announcement held in Prince George Tuesday. "Salmon are relatives. They are a part of our culture, our identity, our laws, our responsibilities."

southeast.title: Wildfire north of Castlegar now mapped at 116 hectares
southeast.description: The B.C. Wildfire Service said helicopters were engaged to hold the fire through until rappel crews responded on Wednesday morning.

all.title: The where, when and how of fuel treatment decisions
all.description: With a big landscape, a limited budget and a diverse set of community objectives, how do we decide where, when and how fuel treatments are best undertaken to reduce wildfire risks? all.title: Studying combined fuel treatments gives us a better picture of effectiveness
all.description: While many studies have established that fuel treatments are an effective wildfire mitigation tool, the gap in our understanding has been how a range of different treatments work together over many years across large areas to produce a desired outcome. all.title: Questions raised about B.C.’s approach to prescribed burns ahead of wildfire season
all.description: The prescribed burn was part of an 87-hectare risk reduction strategy, but the BC Wildfire Service has not yet confirmed whether the burn went ahead as planned.
